prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: deep magenta. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture, print dots and small pieces of tape.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Every surface is matte printed paper reflecting only the room light: cutouts, chips, ribbons and ground all read as photographed paper, with the same flat finish edge to edge. No glow, neon, bloom or halo anywhere.
7. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
8. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip, large, with safe margins. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: deep magenta.
Subjects: a growing paper column; paper coins.
Opens on the folder stack, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The previous chip flips down as the folder stack rises into a tall paper column; coins pile at its base and hold.
Ends holding on the column.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "G&A $8.1M".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "G&A $8.1M". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "General costs rose three point four million, to eight point one.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a cinematic, 2D-animated modern editorial paper collage, photographed as a flat lay under soft, natural room light. The scene opens on <Picture 1>, featuring a deep magenta, single-color matte paper ground. In the upper third of the frame, a cream-colored paper chip with a rough white torn edge displays the black, extra-bold sans-serif text "4 ACQUISITIONS". In the lower two-thirds, a stack of black-and-white halftone photographic paper folder cutouts with rough white torn edges rests on the magenta surface. A consistent light source from the upper left creates small, soft shadows beneath every paper layer.

Immediately on the first frame, a narrator (S1), a male with a warm, clear, and natural mid-range timbre speaking at a brisk but unhurried rate, says: <d>[English] General costs rose three point four million, to eight point one.</d> Simultaneously, the "4 ACQUISITIONS" chip flips downward rapidly with a slight overshoot, disappearing from view. The folder stack in the center begins to rise and multiply, transforming through fast, rhythmic motion into a tall, vertical paper column of grayscale folder cutouts. As the column reaches its peak height, several blank, unmarked black-and-white halftone paper coins with torn white edges slide in quickly from the sides, piling up neatly at the base of the column. 

As the coins settle, a new cream-colored paper chip slides in from the top edge and lands firmly in the upper third of the frame. Printed on this chip in clean, stable, extra-bold black sans-serif typography is the text "G&A $8.1M". The camera remains a Static Shot throughout the 5-second duration. The final second holds on the composition of the tall paper column, the coin pile, and the "G&A $8.1M" headline, with all elements maintaining their matte paper texture and soft shadows.

overall_soundscape: The audio is dominated by the narrator's voice. Beneath the speech, distinct diegetic sound effects occur: a crisp, tactile paper-slap as the chip flips and the column rises, and a series of light, rhythmic "ticking" or "tapping" sounds as the paper coins slide and pile at the base. A faint, sticky sound of adhesive tape is heard as the final headline chip lands.
